label: preparing
what: A jubilee celebration for my forty years as mayor, apparently arranged around the eighteen-hundred great-hall lantern inspection and builder escort. Baker, Freight and innkeeper are organizing a large fresh-bread supply, with 152 loaves verified and 48 still outstanding at the last report; secretary coordinates reports and scheduling, and builder provides the inspection escort. Neighbour likely helps maintain the tea/inspection cover, though her knowing involvement is less certain. The jubilee is already suspected in my journal, but its full arrangements have not been disclosed.
